name: Prosti menja
source:
Blizzard. A boy wades through the snow to find a treasure that will supposedly make amends to his mother. The boy does not know whether his friend has deceived him and whether the treasure is real. However, the only thing left to do is to move forward 

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/topic-223504963_49583002]VK[/url]]
translation:
暴风雪。一个男孩趟过雪地寻找宝藏，据说这可以弥补他母亲的罪过。男孩不知道他的朋友是否欺骗了他，也不知道宝藏是否是真的。然而，唯一要做的就是继续前进
